complete_link_finding: Complete-link correctly prevents A from joining the C-G group because A-D and A-E lack the RC-52 gate; no merge relaxation is proposed.
cross_language_finding: Not independently recalculated here: the existing RC66 package reports 13% cross-language versus 6% same-language split observations, but the present labelled pair sources lack a language stratum.

decision.denominator: 11 Run #39 same-occurrence pairs not in the final same EventGroup
decision.most_frequent_earliest_barrier: NOMINATION_COVERAGE (7/11 in exact Run #39 RC-52 trace; corpus-generalization not proven)
decision.numerator: 7 Run #39 non-final same-occurrence pairs with earliest NOMINATION_COVERAGE barrier
decision.primary_hypothesis: Among independently labelled same-occurrence pairs, insufficient valid joint nomination in fewer than two of three RC-52 procedures is the most frequent earliest barrier before final SAME.
decision.rationale: Run #39's earliest-barrier counts are {'COMPLETE_LINK': 3, 'CONFIRMATION': 1, 'NOMINATION_COVERAGE': 7, 'NO_FAILURE': 10}. The legacy labelled corpus supplies a nomination-coverage signal (9/61 same pairs with fewer than two nomination snapshots in run 40999869397), but it is not a three-procedure RC-52 denominator and run 41018554355 has no nomination snapshots.

additional_excluded_sources.reason: Existing labels are explicitly title/leading-Evidence proxies, not the independent full-Evidence truth required here.

excluded_historical_evidence.exclusion_reason: Rows are audit/title-excerpt judgments, not independently labelled occurrence pairs; the matrix contains proposal opportunities only and therefore cannot supply a never-nominated denominator.

source.description: EVENTIDENTITY_PROPOSAL_CONFIRMATION_MATRIX: every record pair a batch nomination proposed (runs #24-#34, which record exchanges): nomination count, confirmations that kept or separated the pair, final grouping, and whether both separated events reached the report.

false_merge_safety_finding: Run #39 has no different-occurrence labelled pairs. The validated recorded-answer corpus observed zero false SAME pair acceptances for both available runs; the unlabelled Phase B matrix is excluded from the truth denominator.

source.labels_provenance: Real Event Identity helper answers on real records of two live runs (IDs only: no source text). Records are named by candidate ID with the number of excerpt sentences sent; labels are occurrence labels checked by hand against the Evidence (section A.34).

limitations: Run #39 has an independent occurrence label for the seven target candidates but no different-occurrence labels.
recorded_answers.json has hand-checked labels but legacy answer snapshots, not a complete three-procedure RC-52 trace.
The Phase B matrix is intentionally excluded from truth metrics because it is not independently labelled.
The Phase A title-proxy labels are also excluded from the primary truth denominator.
No language, detail-mechanism, or publisher strata are inferred from candidate IDs or titles.
mixed_detail_finding: The current labelled artifact does not contain an independently coded mixed-detail stratum; Run #39 confirmation splits are retained per pair without inventing a mechanism label.
pure_duplicate_finding: Run #39 has five same-occurrence pairs never jointly nominated and three nominated in only one of three procedures; historical Phase B pure-duplicate examples remain unlabelled audit evidence.
rc44_variance_finding: Run 40999869397 has 40/61, 52/61, and 58/61 same-occurrence pairs accepted in three nomination snapshots; the reversed snapshot improves coverage, but this is not a controlled RC-44 order effect.
